1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# Regression test for a real production incident (2026-08-27): consumer CI
     3	# (orin-dx/michi) failed to install callisto because setup-callisto's
     4	# fallback chain never tried crates.io -- only a GitHub Release binary
     5	# tarball (which has no assets attached to any release, always 404s) and
     6	# `cargo install --git` (broken on main by an unrelated yanked dependency).
     7	# callisto-cli@0.5.0 was already published and installable from crates.io
     8	# the whole time. This proves the new crates.io fallback is actually tried,
     9	# in the right order, with the right args, before the git-source fallback.
    10	set -u
    11	INSTALL_SCRIPT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)/scripts/install-callisto.sh"
    12	
    13	extract_snippet() {
    14	  # Starts after the TAG_NAME assignment line -- the caller sets TAG_NAME
    15	  # directly instead. Uses explicit line numbers, not a `fi`-pattern range,
    16	  # because the block contains a nested if/elif/fi (OS detection) before the
    17	  # outer if/elif/elif/else/fi this test targets -- a pattern-based range
    18	  # would stop at the first (inner) `fi` it finds.
    19	  local start end
    20	  start=$(grep -n '# Detect OS platform architecture for pre-built binaries' "$INSTALL_SCRIPT" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
    21	  end=$(grep -n 'CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" >> \$GITHUB_PATH' "$INSTALL_SCRIPT" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
    22	  end=$((end - 1))
    23	  sed -n "${start},${end}p" "$INSTALL_SCRIPT"
    24	}
    25	
    26	run_case() {
    27	  local version="$1"
    28	  local curl_behavior="$2"    # "fail" or "succeed"
    29	  local cargo_behavior="$3"   # "crates-io-succeeds" or "crates-io-fails"
    30	  local calls_file tmp_script workdir
    31	  calls_file="$(mktemp)"
    32	  workdir="$(mktemp -d)"
    33	  tmp_script="$(mktemp)"
    34	  {
    35	    echo "curl() { echo \"curl \$*\" >> '${calls_file}'; [[ '${curl_behavior}' == fail ]] && return 1 || return 0; }"
    36	    echo "tar() { return 0; }"
    37	    echo "unzip() { return 99; }"
    38	    echo "git() { return 99; }"
    39	    echo "gh() { echo \"gh \$*\" >> '${calls_file}'; return 1; }"
    40	    echo "cargo() {"
    41	    echo "  echo \"cargo \$*\" >> '${calls_file}'"
    42	    echo "  if [[ \"\$1\" == install && \"\$*\" == *'callisto-cli'* && \"\$*\" != *'--git'* ]]; then"
    43	    echo "    [[ '${cargo_behavior}' == crates-io-succeeds ]] && { mkdir -p \"\${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin\"; touch \"\${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto\"; return 0; } || return 1"
    44	    echo "  fi"
    45	    echo "  if [[ \"\$*\" == *'--git'* ]]; then"
    46	    echo "    mkdir -p \"\${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin\"; touch \"\${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto\"; return 0"
    47	    echo "  fi"
    48	    echo "}"
    49	    echo "cp() { command cp \"\$@\"; }"
    50	    echo "mkdir() { command mkdir \"\$@\"; }"
    51	    echo "grep() { command grep \"\$@\"; }"
    52	    echo "uname() { [[ \"\$1\" == -s ]] && echo Linux || echo x86_64; }"
    53	    echo "RUNNER_TEMP='${workdir}'"
    54	    echo "GITHUB_WORKSPACE='${workdir}/not-callisto'"
    55	    echo "mkdir -p \"\$GITHUB_WORKSPACE\""
    56	    echo "GITHUB_PATH='${workdir}/github_path'"
    57	    echo "touch \"\$GITHUB_PATH\""
    58	    echo "TAG_NAME='${version}'"
    59	    echo "SOURCE=auto"
    60	    echo "CALLISTO_BIN_DIR='${workdir}/callisto-bin'"
    61	    echo "mkdir -p '${workdir}/callisto-bin'"
    62	    extract_snippet
    63	  } > "$tmp_script"
    64	  bash "$tmp_script" 2>/dev/null
    65	  local code=$?
    66	  cat "$calls_file"
    67	  rm -f "$tmp_script" "$calls_file"
    68	  rm -rf "$workdir"
    69	  return $code
    70	}
    71	
    72	fail=0
    73	
    74	# crates.io install must be attempted (and succeed) before the git fallback,
    75	# when the GH-release binary download fails and version="latest".
    76	out=$(run_case "latest" "fail" "crates-io-succeeds")
    77	if [[ "$out" != *"cargo install callisto-cli --locked"* ]]; then
    78	  echo "FAIL: crates.io install (latest) must be attempted, got: $out"; fail=1
    79	elif [[ "$out" == *"--git"* ]]; then
    80	  echo "FAIL: git fallback must not run when crates.io install succeeds, got: $out"; fail=1
    81	else
    82	  echo "PASS: crates.io install (latest) attempted, git fallback skipped"
    83	fi
    84	
    85	# An explicit "callisto-cli@0.5.0" version must strip to a bare "0.5.0" for
    86	# `cargo install --version`.
    87	out=$(run_case "callisto-cli@0.5.0" "fail" "crates-io-succeeds")
    88	if [[ "$out" != *"--version 0.5.0"* ]]; then
    89	  echo "FAIL: explicit version must strip the callisto-cli@ prefix, got: $out"; fail=1
    90	else
    91	  echo "PASS: explicit version tag strips to bare semver for --version"
    92	fi
    93	
    94	# When crates.io install also fails, the git-source fallback must still run
    95	# (it isn't removed, just demoted to last resort).
    96	out=$(run_case "latest" "fail" "crates-io-fails")
    97	if [[ "$out" != *"--git"* ]]; then
    98	  echo "FAIL: git fallback must still run when crates.io install fails too, got: $out"; fail=1
    99	else
   100	  echo "PASS: git fallback still runs when crates.io install fails"
   101	fi
   102	
   103	for version in callisto@0.5.0 callisto-cli@0.5.0 0.5.0; do
   104	  out=$(run_case "$version" fail crates-io-fails); code=$?
   105	  if [[ $code -eq 0 || "$out" != *"--version 0.5.0"* || "$out" == *"--git"* ]]; then
   106	    echo "FAIL: unavailable pin $version must fail without git fallback: code=$code out=$out"; fail=1
   107	  else
   108	    echo "PASS: unavailable pin $version fails without git fallback"
   109	  fi
   110	done
   111	
   112	exit $fail

use std::io::{self, Write};

use serde::Serialize;

use crate::cli::OutputFormat;

pub fn write_json<W: io::Write, S: Serialize + ?Sized>(w: &mut W, val: &S) -> io::Result<()> {
    let text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(val)?;
    writeln!(w, "{text}")
}

/// Serializes any `Report` value to the one JSON success envelope every
/// command shares: `{schemaVersion, command, dryRun, ...payload,
/// diagnostics}`. `command` comes from `R::COMMAND`, `schemaVersion` from
/// the payload's own `Report::schema_version()` (re-inserted at the top
/// level rather than left flattened, so it appears exactly once). Callers
/// pass their `Report` to this function instead of hand-building a JSON envelope.
pub fn emit_report<W: io::Write, R: callisto_model::Report>(w: &mut W, val: &R, dry_run: bool) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut value = serde_json::to_value(val)?;
    if let serde_json::Value::Object(map) = &mut value {
        map.insert("schemaVersion".to_string(), serde_json::json!(val.schema_version()));
        map.insert("command".to_string(), serde_json::json!(R::COMMAND));
        map.insert("dryRun".to_string(), serde_json::json!(dry_run));
    }
    let text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&value)?;
    writeln!(w, "{text}")
}

/// Writes `bytes` to stdout. A closed reading end (e.g. `callisto ... | head`)
/// is not a failure -- it's the normal way a consumer stops reading -- so a
/// `BrokenPipe` is swallowed here instead of propagating, which is what
/// makes this the one sink callers use in place of `println!` (which panics
/// on that same condition).
pub fn write_stdout(bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
    write_swallowing_broken_pipe(&mut io::stdout(), bytes)
}

/// The actual classification [`write_stdout`] applies, pulled out so a test
/// can exercise it against a real closed pipe without touching the
/// process's real (unredirectable, in-process) stdout fd.
fn write_swallowing_broken_pipe<W: Write>(w: &mut W, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
    match w.write_all(bytes) {
        Ok(()) => Ok(()),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe => Ok(()),
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}

/// Writes one line (plus trailing newline) through [`write_stdout`].
pub fn emit_line(line: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    write_stdout(format!("{line}\n").as_bytes())
}

/// Writes one line to stderr -- for interactive wizard narration
/// (`callisto add`'s step prompts), which must stay off stdout so a script
/// piping stdout never sees prompt text mixed into a report or changeset preview.
pub fn prompt_line(line: &str) {
    eprintln!("{line}");
}

pub fn log_line(format: OutputFormat, line: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    match format {
        OutputFormat::Json => {
            eprintln!("{line}");
            Ok(())
        }
        OutputFormat::Text => emit_line(line),
    }
}

      echo "FAIL ($label): verify rejected unchanged decide output: $verify_output"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regression test for the download/extraction format dispatch in
# scripts/install-callisto.sh. Extracts the actual script body by a real
# text anchor -- the "# Validate verification mode" comment through the end
# of the file -- so this test always exercises the file's current real
# logic; it cannot silently drift from it.
#
# Version resolution is covered separately; these fixtures supply the resolved tag.
set -u
ACTION_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
ACTION_YML="$ACTION_DIR/action.yml"
INSTALL_SCRIPT="$ACTION_DIR/scripts/install-callisto.sh"

extract_snippet() {
  sed -n '/# Validate verification mode/,$p' "$INSTALL_SCRIPT"
}

# Runs the extracted snippet with uname/curl stubbed per test case, and
# tar/unzip/cargo/cp always stubbed to record invocations into calls_file.
# GITHUB_WORKSPACE points at an empty temp dir (no Cargo.toml present, so the
# local-monorepo-build branch is always skipped here) and RUNNER_TEMP /
# CALLISTO_BIN_DIR / GITHUB_PATH point at temp paths.
run_case() {
  local uname_s="$1"
  local uname_m="$2"
  local curl_exit="$3"
  local gh_mode="${4:-ok}"
  local mode="${5-}"
  local tag="${6:-latest}"
  local calls_file workspace runner_temp bin_dir github_path tmp_script
  calls_file="$(mktemp)"
  workspace="$(mktemp -d)"
  runner_temp="$(mktemp -d)"
  bin_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  github_path="$(mktemp)"
  tmp_script="$(mktemp)"
  local isolated_path
  isolated_path="$(mktemp -d)"
  for t in tr grep rm; do ln -s "$(command -v "$t")" "$isolated_path/$t"; done
  {
    printf 'uname() {\n'
    printf '  case "$1" in\n'
    printf '    -s) echo %q ;;\n' "$uname_s"
    printf '    -m) echo %q ;;\n' "$uname_m"
    printf '    *) return 99 ;;\n'
    printf '  esac\n'
    printf '}\n'
    printf 'curl() { echo "curl $*" >> %q; [[ %q -eq 0 ]] && : > "${@: -1}"; return %q; }\n' "$calls_file" "$curl_exit" "$curl_exit"
    printf 'tar() { echo "tar $*" >> %q; return 0; }\n' "$calls_file"
    printf 'unzip() { echo "unzip $*" >> %q; return 0; }\n' "$calls_file"
    printf 'cargo() { echo "cargo $*" >> %q; return 0; }\n' "$calls_file"
    printf 'cp() { echo "cp $*" >> %q; return 0; }\n' "$calls_file"
    printf 'git() { echo "unexpected git $*" >> %q; return 99; }\n' "$calls_file"
    case "$gh_mode" in
      ok) printf 'gh() { echo "gh $*" >> %q; return 0; }\n' "$calls_file" ;;
      fail) printf 'gh() { echo "gh $*" >> %q; return 1; }\n' "$calls_file" ;;
      missing) printf 'PATH=%q\n' "$isolated_path" ;;
    esac
    [[ -n "$mode" ]] && printf 'INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION=%q\n' "$mode"
    printf 'GITHUB_WORKSPACE=%q\n' "$workspace"
    printf 'RUNNER_TEMP=%q\n' "$runner_temp"
    printf 'CALLISTO_BIN_DIR=%q\n' "$bin_dir"
    printf 'GITHUB_PATH=%q\n' "$github_path"
    printf 'TAG_NAME=%q\n' "$tag"
    printf 'SOURCE=auto\n'
    extract_snippet
  } > "$tmp_script"
  bash "$tmp_script"
  local code=$?
  [[ -e "$runner_temp/callisto.tar.gz" ]] && echo "ASSET_PRESENT"
  echo "---CALLS---"
  cat "$calls_file"
  rm -f "$tmp_script" "$calls_file" "$github_path"
  rm -rf "$workspace" "$runner_temp" "$bin_dir" "$isolated_path"
  return $code
}

fail=0

# 1. Windows is not a supported product-binary target. It must skip a
# fictitious download and use the established installation fallback.
out=$(run_case "MINGW64_NT-10.0" "x86_64" 0); code=$?
if [[ $code -ne 0 ]] \
  || [[ "$out" == *"tar -xzf"* ]] \
  || [[ "$out" == *"unzip"* ]] \
  || [[ "$out" != *"cargo install callisto-cli"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_windows_falls_back_without_fictitious_asset: code=$code out=$out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_windows_falls_back_without_fictitious_asset"
fi

# 2. macOS arm64 regression -> unchanged tar.gz behavior, unzip not invoked.

name: 'Callisto Validate Action'
description: 'Validates pending changesets, package discovery, configuration health, and release plan DAG'

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Setup Callisto Environment
      uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto

    - name: Validate Configuration, Package Discovery & Changesets
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      # `callisto status --check` is a conventional
      # 0/1 gate: 0 when there are no error-level diagnostics, 1 otherwise,
      # regardless of pending changesets. `shell: bash` already fails the step
      # on a non-zero exit, so no wrapper is needed.
      run: callisto status --check

    - name: Pre-Flight Release Plan Simulation (DAG Pre-Check)
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      run: |
        echo "::group::Simulating Release Plan"
        callisto release --dry-run --format text
        echo "::endgroup::"

    - name: Render PR Release Pre-Flight Summary
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      run: |
        echo "### Callisto Release Pre-Flight Verification" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Package Discovery**: All workspace crates and packages are correctly tracked." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Configuration Health**: \`callisto.toml\` schema and rules are valid." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Changeset Integrity**: Pending changesets are valid." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "#### Workspace Package Status" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        callisto status >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = ["crates/*"]

[workspace.package]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.96"
repository = "https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto"
homepage = "https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/callisto-cli"
keywords = ["monorepo", "changesets", "release-management", "versioning", "moon"]
categories = ["development-tools", "command-line-utilities"]

# Pinned once here, not per-crate: bump_version's byte-exactness claim
# is meaningless if two crates in the workspace disagree about what SemVer parsing
# and rendering do.
[workspace.dependencies]
semver = { version = "1", features = ["serde"] }
pep440_rs = "0.7"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["preserve_order"] }
thiserror = "1"
indexmap = { version = "2", features = ["serde"] }
toml_edit = "0.22"
ignore = "0.4"
toml = "0.8"
globset = "0.4"
camino = { version = "1", features = ["serde1"] }
dunce = "1"
path-slash = "0.2"
tempfile = "3"
miette = { version = "7", features = ["fancy"] }
petgraph = "0.6"
tracing = "0.1"
rstest = "0.23"
insta = { version = "1.41", features = ["json", "redactions"] }
proptest = "1"
schemars = "0.8"
serial_test = "3"
yaml-rust2 = { version = "0.11", default-features = false }
sha2 = "0.10"
base64 = "0.22"
fs2 = "0.4"
url = "2.5.8"

[profile.release]
lto = true
opt-level = 3
codegen-units = 1
# Ship without the symbol table: ~15% smaller binaries, no debug info either way.
strip = true

# Centralized workspace lints (stable since Rust 1.74)
[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
unused_must_use = "deny"
let_underscore_drop = "deny"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
all = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
unwrap_used = "allow"
expect_used = "allow"
let_underscore_must_use = "deny"
let_underscore_untyped = "deny"
map_err_ignore = "deny"
module_name_repetitions = "allow"
must_use_candidate = "allow"
[package]
name = "callisto-cli"
version = "0.8.0"
edition.workspace = true
license = "FSL-1.1-MIT"
description = "Callisto Release Engine — Polyglot monorepo versioning and release management CLI."
repository.workspace = true
readme = "README.md"

[lints]
workspace = true

[[bin]]
name = "callisto"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
callisto-graph = { path = "../callisto-graph", version = "0.8.0" }
callisto-manifests = { path = "../callisto-manifests", version = "0.8.0" }
callisto-model = { path = "../callisto-model", version = "0.8.0" }
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive", "env", "string"] }
clap_complete = "4"
serde = { workspace = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true }
thiserror = { workspace = true }
indexmap = { workspace = true }
miette = { workspace = true }
anstream = "0.6"
comfy-table = "7"
similar = { version = "2", features = ["inline"] }
schemars = { workspace = true }
dialoguer = "0.11"
dunce = { workspace = true }
path-slash = { workspace = true }
tempfile = { workspace = true }

[dev-dependencies]

tempfile = { workspace = true }

name: 'Callisto Validate Action'
description: 'Validates pending changesets, package discovery, configuration health, and release plan DAG'

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Setup Callisto Environment
      uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto

    - name: Validate Configuration, Package Discovery & Changesets
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      # `callisto status --check` is a conventional
      # 0/1 gate: 0 when there are no error-level diagnostics, 1 otherwise,
      # regardless of pending changesets. `shell: bash` already fails the step
      # on a non-zero exit, so no wrapper is needed.
      run: callisto status --check

    - name: Pre-Flight Release Plan Simulation (DAG Pre-Check)
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      run: |
        echo "::group::Simulating Release Plan"
        callisto release --dry-run --format text
        echo "::endgroup::"

    - name: Render PR Release Pre-Flight Summary
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      run: |
        echo "### Callisto Release Pre-Flight Verification" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Package Discovery**: All workspace crates and packages are correctly tracked." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Configuration Health**: \`callisto.toml\` schema and rules are valid." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Changeset Integrity**: Pending changesets are valid." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "#### Workspace Package Status" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        callisto status >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

name: 'Callisto Validate Action'
description: 'Validates pending changesets, package discovery, configuration health, and release plan DAG'

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Setup Callisto Environment
      uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto

    - name: Validate Configuration, Package Discovery & Changesets
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      # `callisto status --check` is a conventional
      # 0/1 gate: 0 when there are no error-level diagnostics, 1 otherwise,
      # regardless of pending changesets. `shell: bash` already fails the step
      # on a non-zero exit, so no wrapper is needed.
      run: callisto status --check

    - name: Pre-Flight Release Plan Simulation (DAG Pre-Check)
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      run: |
        echo "::group::Simulating Release Plan"
        callisto release --dry-run --format text
        echo "::endgroup::"

    - name: Render PR Release Pre-Flight Summary
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      run: |
        echo "### Callisto Release Pre-Flight Verification" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Package Discovery**: All workspace crates and packages are correctly tracked." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Configuration Health**: \`callisto.toml\` schema and rules are valid." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Changeset Integrity**: Pending changesets are valid." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "#### Workspace Package Status" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        callisto status >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

+++ b/.github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_decide_binary_contract.sh
@@ -129,6 +129,110 @@ else
   echo 'PASS (create, no existing PR): real binary output round-trips through the script'"'"'s jq expressions'
 fi
 
+assert_verify_transport() {
+  local label="$1" decision_json="$2" snapshot_json="$3" transport="$4"
+  local decision_arg verify_output
+  case "$transport" in
+    inline) decision_arg="$decision_json" ;;
+    file)
+      decision_arg="$repo/decision.json"
+      jq . <<< "$decision_json" > "$decision_arg"
+      ;;
+    stdin) decision_arg=- ;;
+    *) echo "FAIL ($label): unknown transport '$transport'"; fail=1; return ;;
+  esac
+  if [[ "$transport" == stdin ]]; then
+    verify_output=$("$callisto_bin" --format json release-pr verify --decision - --snapshot "$snapshot_json" \
+      --cwd "$repo" <<< "$decision_json") || {
+      echo "FAIL ($label): verify rejected unchanged decide output: $verify_output"
+      fail=1
+      return
+    }
+  else
+    verify_output=$("$callisto_bin" --format json release-pr verify --decision "$decision_arg" \
+      --snapshot "$snapshot_json" --cwd "$repo") || {
+      echo "FAIL ($label): verify rejected unchanged decide output: $verify_output"
+      fail=1
+      return
+    }
+  fi
+  if [[ "$(jq -r '.ok' <<< "$verify_output")" != true ]]; then
+    echo "FAIL ($label): verify did not report success: $verify_output"
+    fail=1
+  else
+    echo "PASS ($label): decide output verifies unchanged"
+  fi
+}
+
+update_snapshot=$(jq -cn --arg repository 'orin-dx/callisto' --arg base_branch main --arg base_commit "$base_commit" \
+  --arg head_commit "$base_commit" \
+  '{schemaVersion: 2, repository: $repository, baseBranch: $base_branch, baseCommit: $base_commit,
+    openPullRequests: [{number: 42, headRepository: $repository, headBranch: "callisto/version-packages",
+    headCommit: $head_commit}]}')
+create_snapshot=$(jq -cn --arg repository 'orin-dx/callisto' --arg base_branch main --arg base_commit "$base_commit" \
+  '{schemaVersion: 2, repository: $repository, baseBranch: $base_branch, baseCommit: $base_commit, openPullRequests: []}')
+update_decision=$("$callisto_bin" --format json release-pr decide --snapshot "$update_snapshot" \
+  --repository orin-dx/callisto --base-branch main --release-branch callisto/version-packages --cwd "$repo")
+create_decision=$("$callisto_bin" --format json release-pr decide --snapshot "$create_snapshot" \
+  --repository orin-dx/callisto --base-branch main --release-branch callisto/version-packages --cwd "$repo")
+for transport in inline file stdin; do
+  assert_verify_transport "update via $transport" "$update_decision" "$update_snapshot" "$transport"
+  assert_verify_transport "create via $transport" "$create_decision" "$create_snapshot" "$transport"
+done
+
+# A workspace with no pending changesets produces the no-op decision.
+rm "$repo/.changeset/test-change.md"
+noop_decision=$("$callisto_bin" --format json release-pr decide --snapshot "$create_snapshot" \
+  --repository orin-dx/callisto --base-branch main --release-branch callisto/version-packages --cwd "$repo")
+if [[ "$(jq -r '.action.kind' <<< "$noop_decision")" != noop ]]; then
+  echo "FAIL (no-op decision): expected kind=noop, got: $noop_decision"
+  fail=1
+else
+  for transport in inline file stdin; do
+    assert_verify_transport "no-op via $transport" "$noop_decision" "$create_snapshot" "$transport"
+  done
+fi
+
+# Verify also accepts the durable decision shape without report metadata.
+unwrapped_decision=$(jq -c 'del(.command, .dryRun)' <<< "$update_decision")
+for transport in inline file stdin; do
+  assert_verify_transport "unwrapped decision via $transport" "$unwrapped_decision" "$update_snapshot" "$transport"
+done
+
+assert_verify_rejects() {
+  local label="$1" decision_json="$2" snapshot_json="$3" expected_code="$4" output status
+  set +e
+  output=$("$callisto_bin" --format json release-pr verify --decision "$decision_json" --snapshot "$snapshot_json" \
+    --cwd "$repo" 2>&1)
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if [[ "$status" -eq 0 ]]; then
+    echo "FAIL ($label): verify unexpectedly accepted input: $output"
+    fail=1
+  elif [[ -n "$expected_code" && "$(jq -r '.error.code // empty' <<< "$output")" != "$expected_code" ]]; then
+    echo "FAIL ($label): expected diagnostic $expected_code, got: $output"
+    fail=1
+  else
+    echo "PASS ($label): verify rejected invalid input"
+  fi
+}
+
+assert_verify_rejects 'malformed decision JSON' '{not json' "$update_snapshot" E281
+assert_verify_rejects 'unsupported decision schema' "$(jq -c '.schemaVersion = 1' <<< "$update_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E155
+assert_verify_rejects 'wrong report command' "$(jq -c '.command = "release-pr decide-old"' <<< "$update_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E281
+assert_verify_rejects 'null report command' "$(jq -c '.command = null' <<< "$update_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E281
+assert_verify_rejects 'null report metadata' "$(jq -c '.dryRun = null' <<< "$update_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E281
+assert_verify_rejects 'wrong report metadata type' "$(jq -c '.dryRun = "false"' <<< "$update_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E281
+assert_verify_rejects 'partial report metadata' "$(jq -c 'del(.dryRun)' <<< "$update_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E281
+assert_verify_rejects 'partial report command' "$(jq -c 'del(.command)' <<< "$update_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E281
+assert_verify_rejects 'unknown decision payload field' "$(jq -c '.unexpected = true' <<< "$unwrapped_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E281
+assert_verify_rejects 'invalid nested config branch' "$(jq -c '.config.releaseBranch = "bad..branch"' <<< "$unwrapped_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E142
+assert_verify_rejects 'invalid nested snapshot schema' "$(jq -c '.snapshot.schemaVersion = 1' <<< "$unwrapped_decision")" "$update_snapshot" E155
+stale_snapshot=$(jq -c '.baseCommit = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"' <<< "$update_snapshot")
+assert_verify_rejects 'stale snapshot' "$update_decision" "$stale_snapshot" E148
+wrong_repository_snapshot=$(jq -c '.repository = "other/callisto"' <<< "$update_snapshot")
+assert_verify_rejects 'wrong snapshot repository' "$update_decision" "$wrong_repository_snapshot" E148
+
 # release-pr commit-plan: stage a known change and verify the exact jq
 # mapping create-or-update-release-pr.sh applies to build the GraphQL
 # createCommitOnBranch body, including base64 content, against real output.

# Explicit compatibility path for contributors who do not have cargo-nextest
# installed. It is never used by CI or pre-merge verification.
test-moon:
    moon run :test
    cargo test --doc --workspace

# Exercise the Release-PR action's real shell block with Git and GitHub API
# boundaries faked. This proves the script's control flow given a decision
# shape; it does not call the real `callisto` binary, so it cannot catch a
# mismatch between what Callisto actually serializes and what this script's
# jq expressions expect. See test-release-action-binary for that check.
test-release-action:
    bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_contract.sh

# Compiles callisto and runs the Release-PR action's jq extraction against
# its real JSON output. Requires pending changesets to exercise update and
# supersede decisions; skips cleanly otherwise.
test-release-action-binary:
    bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_decide_binary_contract.sh

# Execute the release lifecycle at the real CLI boundary with fake registry,
# Git, forge, and attestation providers. This is deliberately separate from
# broad workspace tests so PR CI makes the release behavior evidence visible.

# Workflow Contracts CI job minus actionlint and zizmor: pins, release
# contract/policy, artifact build script, the Release-PR action contract
# under a minimal PATH, and the installer verification-mode tests.
workflow-contracts: release-workflow-checks
    bash .github/tests/verify-action-pins.sh
    bash .github/tests/test-release-artifact-build-script.sh
    env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_contract.sh
    env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_contract.sh
    bash .github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_download_extraction_format.sh
    bash .github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_action_ref_version_resolution.sh
    bash .github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_crates_io_fallback.sh

# Every check CI runs except actionlint (Docker) and the binary-dependent
# release-PR decide contract and artifact preflight build. CI runs them as
# parallel jobs (callisto-ci.yml); locally they run in sequence.
ci: fmt-check lint test audit doc-check zizmor workflow-contracts release-workflow-behavior (coverage "90")

docs/publishing.md-101-`setup-callisto` defaults to `source: auto`: install the requested release, even inside a Callisto checkout. An explicit `version` overrides action-ref resolution; otherwise `latest` resolves the pinned action ref to its `callisto@` release when possible. Git, Cargo and jq must be available; locked offline metadata resolution must succeed. The build uses the checkout's manifest and a dedicated runner-temporary output directory. Invalid source fails instead of falling back to a released binary. Callisto's own release jobs explicitly use this mode.

docs/publishing.md-108-- `fallback` (default): on failure or missing `gh`, warn, delete the asset, and install from crates.io instead (version pinned to the requested tag; unpinned only for `latest`). The unverified asset is never run.

item.stdout:
## Integration risks and evidence gaps

- Status changeset attribution and well-formedness checks still scan display ids through `PackageId::resolve_unique`, while version aggregation uses `IdentityIndex::resolve_id`. Source-visible resolver divergence can reject a valid secondary native name or accept an unrelated qualified selector. Add a paired status/version fixture and migrate both status helpers with the other selector consumers (T06).
- NAPI publication hooks can own the same platform/GitHub effects as Callisto. Official hook behavior and Callisto's lifecycle-enabled npm argv establish the risk; a combined generated-workflow fixture is still required (T10-NAPI).
- Registry version existence is not proof of identical package bytes, complete Python files or the desired npm dist-tag. Artifact-set completion is a correctness fix (T09); universal checksum enforcement and channel promotion remain owner decisions.
- PyPI yanking is per file. The current classifier treats any matching yanked file as Absent even alongside non-yanked files. A yank is not deletion or permission to overwrite; confirm conflict/partial semantics with the required-output model (T09).
- Cargo and PyPI real local registry tests exist in `release_real_registry_e2e_tests.rs`; they drive publisher argv directly, bypass production binding/observation in those paths, and can skip when tools are missing. npm has broader end-to-end coverage. Record exercised versus skipped paths; do not mark the missing Cargo test as the remaining v1 blocker (T12).
- No measured evidence establishes the owner's first-published-release-in-under-ten-minutes goal. Run fresh repositories with the documented steps and native credentials (T12-DX).
- Go v2/tag publication and NuGet normalized versions/RID/TFM assets are architecture examples only, not production support or new v1 gates (T07/T08/T12).

## Owner policy, not a defect verdict

Commit inference can produce pending bumps while `hasChangesets` is false; managed release-PR decisions then return noop. Committed verification also requires a consumed changeset, as ADR 2 states. Decide whether inferred-only/manual version releases belong in managed CI before changing that authority. Do not silently accept a reconstructed roster.

Authenticated private PyPI/HTML-only indexes, npm channel promotion, universal registry checksum requirements and automatic wrapper bump severity also need a support/policy decision. The proposed model keeps room for them without making them required implementations.

## v0.9 handoff

Merge the verified T01 correction to unblock release-PR refresh. Then require fresh release-source/decision agreement and passing workflow checks before merging the refreshed PR; do not merge the stale #113 decision as a workaround. [Run 36281315129](https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/actions/runs/36281315129) records the E281 failure that prevented refresh after later merges. No claim that E281 is the only possible publication blocker is established until the actual self-release succeeds.

The publication intent, artifact-manifest and receipt files are written without the stdout report envelope, so the same wrapper mismatch was not found there. That source inspection does not replace executing the publish path.

Preserve cache reuse or configure caching for the new directory; the installed executable can remain under `RUNNER_TEMP`.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# Black-box coverage for the exact release-PR action executable. The fake
     3	# process boundary proves the script executes only Callisto's closed decision
     4	# set and only the forge commit API (never `git push`); Rust tests cover
     5	# decision policy itself.
     6	#

     8	# mismatch between what the real binary serializes and what this script's jq
     9	# expressions expect -- see test_release_pr_decide_binary_contract.sh, which
    10	# calls the compiled binary, for that check.

    12	
    13	action_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    14	script="$action_dir/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh"

    17	  local prs="$1" decision="$2" label_exists="${3:-true}"
    18	  local calls_file output_file harness verify_count_file
    19	  calls_file="$(mktemp)"
    20	  output_file="$(mktemp)"
    21	  verify_count_file="$(mktemp)"
    22	  harness="$(mktemp)"
    23	  rm -f "$verify_count_file"
    24	
    25	  {
    26	    cat <<'STUBS'
    27	callisto() {
    28	  echo "callisto $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
    29	  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr decide '* ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$DECISION"; return 0; fi
    30	  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr verify '* ]]; then
    31	    local n
    32	    n=$(( $(cat "$VERIFY_COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 ))
    33	    echo "$n" > "$VERIFY_COUNT_FILE"
    34	    if [[ "$VERIFY_FAIL_AT" != 0 && "$n" == "$VERIFY_FAIL_AT" ]]; then return 1; fi
    35	    return 0
    36	  fi
    37	  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr commit-plan '* ]]; then
    38	    local out='' prev=''
    39	    for a in "$@"; do
    40	      [[ "$prev" == '--out' ]] && out="$a"
    41	      prev="$a"
    42	    done
    43	    printf '%s\n' "$COMMIT_PLAN" > "$out"
    44	    return "$COMMIT_PLAN_CODE"
    45	  fi
    46	  case "$1" in
    47	    matrix) printf '%s\n' '{"platformTargets":[]}' ;;
    48	    compose-pr-body) echo 'composed release body' ;;
    49	    version) return 0 ;;
    50	    *) echo "unexpected callisto invocation: $*" >&2; return 97 ;;
    51	  esac
    52	}
    53	gh() {
    54	  echo "gh $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
    55	  local joined=" $* "
    56	  case "$1 $2" in
    57	    'pr list') printf '%s\n' "$PR_LIST"; return 0 ;;
    58	    'pr view') echo 'existing body'; return 0 ;;
    59	    'pr create') echo "$PR_CREATE_URL"; return 0 ;;
    60	    'pr edit') return 0 ;;
    61	    'label list') echo "$LABEL_EXISTS"; return 0 ;;
    62	    'label create') return 0 ;;
    63	  esac
    64	  if [[ "$1" == 'api' ]]; then
    65	    if [[ "$joined" == *' graphql '* ]]; then
    66	      [[ "$GRAPHQL_CODE" == 0 ]] || return "$GRAPHQL_CODE"
    67	      printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
    68	      return 0
    69	    fi
    70	    if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/commits/'* ]]; then
    71	      printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_TREE"
    72	      return 0
    73	    fi
    74	    # The bare collection endpoint (`.../git/refs`, no ref name in the URL
    75	    # path -- the branch only appears in the `-f ref=refs/heads/...` value)
    76	    # is used for ref *creation*: the staging-ref POST fallback and the
    77	    # create-decision's initial attempt to create the real branch.
    78	    if [[ "$joined" == *' -X POST '* && "$joined" == *'/git/refs '* ]]; then
    79	      [[ "$joined" == *'ref=refs/heads/'*'--staging'* ]] && return 0
    80	      return "$MOVE_POST_CODE"
    81	    fi
    82	    # `.../git/refs/heads/<branch>` (the branch name in the URL path itself)
    83	    # is used for PATCH (force-update an existing ref), GET (confirm), and
    84	    # DELETE (staging cleanup).
    85	    if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/refs/heads/'* ]]; then
    86	      if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/refs/heads/'*'--staging'* ]]; then
    87	        [[ "$joined" == *' -X PATCH '* ]] && return "$STAGING_PATCH_CODE"

if gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" -F force=true > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  :

        message: {headline: $headline},
        expectedHeadOid: $plan[0].baseCommit,
        fileChanges: {
          additions: [$plan[0].additions[] | {path, contents: .contentsBase64}],
          deletions: $plan[0].deletions
        }
      }
    }
  }' > body.json

  echo "::error::forge commit tree $remote_tree does not match the locally staged tree $local_tree; refusing to move $release_branch"
  exit 1

    gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
  fi
fi
moved_sha=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" --jq '.object.sha')
if [[ "$moved_sha" != "$new_sha" ]]; then
  echo "::error::$release_branch points at $moved_sha after the update, expected $new_sha; a concurrent write may have raced this run"
  exit 1
fi

callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null

label_exists=$(gh label list --limit 1000 --json name --jq 'any(.[]; .name == env.INPUT_PR_LABEL)')
if [[ "$label_exists" != true ]]; then
  gh label create "$INPUT_PR_LABEL" --color 0e8a16 --description 'Callisto release packages'
fi

case "$decision_kind" in
  create)
    gh pr create --head "$release_branch" --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL"
    ;;
  update)
    gh pr edit "$existing_pr" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --add-label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL"
    ;;
esac

staging_created=false
cleanup_staging() {
  if [[ "$staging_created" == true ]]; then
    gh api -X DELETE "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" > /dev/null 2>&1 \
      || echo "::warning::could not delete staging branch $staging_branch; the next run reclaims this deterministic name"
  fi
  rm -f "$plan_file" body.json
}
trap cleanup_staging EXIT

# A local diff does not authorize a stale forge write. Re-observe immediately
# before mutating the remote branch, then again before moving the managed
# ref, then again before GitHub label/PR writes.
callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null

if gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" -F force=true > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  :
else
  gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" > /dev/null
fi
staging_created=true

jq -n \
  --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --arg branch "$staging_branch" \
  --arg headline "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" \
  --slurpfile plan "$plan_file" \
  '{
    query: "mutation($input: CreateCommitOnBranchInput!) { createCommitOnBranch(input: $input) { commit { oid } } }",
    variables: {
      input: {
        branch: {repositoryNameWithOwner: $repo, branchName: $branch},
        message: {headline: $headline},
        expectedHeadOid: $plan[0].baseCommit,
        fileChanges: {
          additions: [$plan[0].additions[] | {path, contents: .contentsBase64}],
          deletions: $plan[0].deletions
        }
      }
    }
  }' > body.json

new_sha=$(gh api graphql --input body.json --jq '.data.createCommitOnBranch.commit.oid')
remote_tree=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/commits/$new_sha" --jq '.tree.sha')
if [[ "$remote_tree" != "$local_tree" ]]; then
  echo "::error::forge commit tree $remote_tree does not match the locally staged tree $local_tree; refusing to move $release_branch"
  exit 1
fi

callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null

if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
  gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
else
  if ! gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
  fi
fi
moved_sha=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" --jq '.object.sha')
if [[ "$moved_sha" != "$new_sha" ]]; then
  echo "::error::$release_branch points at $moved_sha after the update, expected $new_sha; a concurrent write may have raced this run"
  exit 1
fi

callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null

label_exists=$(gh label list --limit 1000 --json name --jq 'any(.[]; .name == env.INPUT_PR_LABEL)')
if [[ "$label_exists" != true ]]; then
  gh label create "$INPUT_PR_LABEL" --color 0e8a16 --description 'Callisto release packages'
fi

case "$decision_kind" in
  create)
    gh pr create --head "$release_branch" --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL"
    ;;
  update)
    gh pr edit "$existing_pr" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --add-label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL"
    ;;
esac

run_case() {
  local prs="$1" decision="$2" label_exists="${3:-true}"
  local calls_file output_file harness verify_count_file
  calls_file="$(mktemp)"
  output_file="$(mktemp)"
  verify_count_file="$(mktemp)"
  harness="$(mktemp)"
  rm -f "$verify_count_file"

  {
    cat <<'STUBS'
callisto() {
  echo "callisto $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr decide '* ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$DECISION"; return 0; fi
  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr verify '* ]]; then
    local n
    n=$(( $(cat "$VERIFY_COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 ))
    echo "$n" > "$VERIFY_COUNT_FILE"
    if [[ "$VERIFY_FAIL_AT" != 0 && "$n" == "$VERIFY_FAIL_AT" ]]; then return 1; fi
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr commit-plan '* ]]; then
    local out='' prev=''
    for a in "$@"; do
      [[ "$prev" == '--out' ]] && out="$a"
      prev="$a"
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$COMMIT_PLAN" > "$out"
    return "$COMMIT_PLAN_CODE"
  fi
  case "$1" in
    matrix) printf '%s\n' '{"platformTargets":[]}' ;;
    compose-pr-body) echo 'composed release body' ;;
    version) return 0 ;;
    *) echo "unexpected callisto invocation: $*" >&2; return 97 ;;
  esac
}
gh() {
  echo "gh $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
  local joined=" $* "
  case "$1 $2" in
    'pr list') printf '%s\n' "$PR_LIST"; return 0 ;;
    'pr view') echo 'existing body'; return 0 ;;
    'pr create') echo "$PR_CREATE_URL"; return 0 ;;
    'pr edit') return 0 ;;
    'label list') echo "$LABEL_EXISTS"; return 0 ;;
    'label create') return 0 ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$1" == 'api' ]]; then
    if [[ "$joined" == *' graphql '* ]]; then
      [[ "$GRAPHQL_CODE" == 0 ]] || return "$GRAPHQL_CODE"
      printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
      return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/commits/'* ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_TREE"
      return 0
    fi
    # The bare collection endpoint (`.../git/refs`, no ref name in the URL
    # path -- the branch only appears in the `-f ref=refs/heads/...` value)
    # is used for ref *creation*: the staging-ref POST fallback and the
    # create-decision's initial attempt to create the real branch.
    if [[ "$joined" == *' -X POST '* && "$joined" == *'/git/refs '* ]]; then
      [[ "$joined" == *'ref=refs/heads/'*'--staging'* ]] && return 0
      return "$MOVE_POST_CODE"
    fi
    # `.../git/refs/heads/<branch>` (the branch name in the URL path itself)
    # is used for PATCH (force-update an existing ref), GET (confirm), and
    # DELETE (staging cleanup).
    if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/refs/heads/'* ]]; then
      if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/refs/heads/'*'--staging'* ]]; then
        [[ "$joined" == *' -X PATCH '* ]] && return "$STAGING_PATCH_CODE"
        return 0
      fi
      [[ "$joined" == *' -X PATCH '* ]] && return "$MOVE_PATCH_CODE"
      printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  return 0
}
git() {
  echo "git $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
  case "$1" in
    rev-parse) echo "$BASE_SHA"; return 0 ;;
    add) return 0 ;;
    status) echo ' M Cargo.toml'; return 0 ;;
    write-tree) echo "$LOCAL_TREE"; return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}
STUBS
  } > "$harness"

  set +e
  CALLS_FILE="$calls_file" PR_LIST="$prs" DECISION="$decision" LABEL_EXISTS="$label_exists" \
    VERIFY_FAIL_AT="${VERIFY_FAIL_AT:-0}" VERIFY_COUNT_FILE="$verify_count_file" \
    STAGING_PATCH_CODE="${STAGING_PATCH_CODE:-0}" GRAPHQL_CODE="${GRAPHQL_CODE:-0}" \
    MOVE_PATCH_CODE="${MOVE_PATCH_CODE:-0}" MOVE_POST_CODE="${MOVE_POST_CODE:-0}" \
    COMMIT_PLAN_CODE="${COMMIT_PLAN_CODE:-0}" COMMIT_PLAN="${COMMIT_PLAN:-$default_commit_plan}" \
    NEW_SHA="${NEW_SHA:-$default_new_sha}" LOCAL_TREE="${LOCAL_TREE:-tree-aaaa}" REMOTE_TREE="${REMOTE_TREE:-tree-aaaa}" \
    PR_CREATE_URL="${PR_CREATE_URL:-https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/pull/99}" \
    BASE_SHA='0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567' GITHUB_OUTPUT="$output_file" \
    INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND='callisto version' \
    INPUT_DECISION_PATH='.callisto/release-decision.json' \
    INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE='chore(release): version packages' \
    INPUT_TITLE='chore(release): version packages' \
    INPUT_PR_LABEL='callisto: release' \
    INPUT_SETUP_GIT_USER=true \
    INPUT_BRANCH=main \
    INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH='callisto/version-packages' \
    INPUT_CWD=. \

}

  local prs="$1" decision="$2" label_exists="${3:-true}"
  local calls_file output_file harness verify_count_file
  calls_file="$(mktemp)"
  output_file="$(mktemp)"
  verify_count_file="$(mktemp)"
  harness="$(mktemp)"
  rm -f "$verify_count_file"

  {
    cat <<'STUBS'
callisto() {
  echo "callisto $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr decide '* ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$DECISION"; return 0; fi
  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr verify '* ]]; then
    local n
    n=$(( $(cat "$VERIFY_COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 ))
    echo "$n" > "$VERIFY_COUNT_FILE"
    if [[ "$VERIFY_FAIL_AT" != 0 && "$n" == "$VERIFY_FAIL_AT" ]]; then return 1; fi
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr commit-plan '* ]]; then
    local out='' prev=''
    for a in "$@"; do
      [[ "$prev" == '--out' ]] && out="$a"
      prev="$a"
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$COMMIT_PLAN" > "$out"
    return "$COMMIT_PLAN_CODE"
  fi
  case "$1" in
    matrix) printf '%s\n' '{"platformTargets":[]}' ;;
    compose-pr-body) echo 'composed release body' ;;
    version) return 0 ;;
    *) echo "unexpected callisto invocation: $*" >&2; return 97 ;;
  esac
}
gh() {
  echo "gh $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
  local joined=" $* "
  case "$1 $2" in
    'pr list') printf '%s\n' "$PR_LIST"; return 0 ;;
    'pr view') echo 'existing body'; return 0 ;;
    'pr create') echo "$PR_CREATE_URL"; return 0 ;;
    'pr edit') return 0 ;;
    'label list') echo "$LABEL_EXISTS"; return 0 ;;
    'label create') return 0 ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$1" == 'api' ]]; then
    if [[ "$joined" == *' graphql '* ]]; then
      [[ "$GRAPHQL_CODE" == 0 ]] || return "$GRAPHQL_CODE"
      printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
      return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/commits/'* ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_TREE"
      return 0
    fi
    # The bare collection endpoint (`.../git/refs`, no ref name in the URL
    # path -- the branch only appears in the `-f ref=refs/heads/...` value)
    # is used for ref *creation*: the staging-ref POST fallback and the
    # create-decision's initial attempt to create the real branch.
    if [[ "$joined" == *' -X POST '* && "$joined" == *'/git/refs '* ]]; then
      [[ "$joined" == *'ref=refs/heads/'*'--staging'* ]] && return 0
      return "$MOVE_POST_CODE"
    fi
    # `.../git/refs/heads/<branch>` (the branch name in the URL path itself)
    # is used for PATCH (force-update an existing ref), GET (confirm), and
    # DELETE (staging cleanup).
    if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/refs/heads/'* ]]; then
      if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/refs/heads/'*'--staging'* ]]; then
        [[ "$joined" == *' -X PATCH '* ]] && return "$STAGING_PATCH_CODE"
        return 0
      fi
      [[ "$joined" == *' -X PATCH '* ]] && return "$MOVE_PATCH_CODE"
      printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  return 0
}
git() {
  echo "git $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
  case "$1" in
    rev-parse) echo "$BASE_SHA"; return 0 ;;
    add) return 0 ;;
    status) echo ' M Cargo.toml'; return 0 ;;
    write-tree) echo "$LOCAL_TREE"; return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}
STUBS
  } > "$harness"

  set +e
  CALLS_FILE="$calls_file" PR_LIST="$prs" DECISION="$decision" LABEL_EXISTS="$label_exists" \
    VERIFY_FAIL_AT="${VERIFY_FAIL_AT:-0}" VERIFY_COUNT_FILE="$verify_count_file" \
    STAGING_PATCH_CODE="${STAGING_PATCH_CODE:-0}" GRAPHQL_CODE="${GRAPHQL_CODE:-0}" \
    MOVE_PATCH_CODE="${MOVE_PATCH_CODE:-0}" MOVE_POST_CODE="${MOVE_POST_CODE:-0}" \
    COMMIT_PLAN_CODE="${COMMIT_PLAN_CODE:-0}" COMMIT_PLAN="${COMMIT_PLAN:-$default_commit_plan}" \
    NEW_SHA="${NEW_SHA:-$default_new_sha}" LOCAL_TREE="${LOCAL_TREE:-tree-aaaa}" REMOTE_TREE="${REMOTE_TREE:-tree-aaaa}" \
    PR_CREATE_URL="${PR_CREATE_URL:-https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/pull/99}" \
    BASE_SHA='0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567' GITHUB_OUTPUT="$output_file" \
    INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND='callisto version' \
    INPUT_DECISION_PATH='.callisto/release-decision.json' \
    INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE='chore(release): version packages' \
    INPUT_TITLE='chore(release): version packages' \
    INPUT_PR_LABEL='callisto: release' \
    INPUT_SETUP_GIT_USER=true \
    INPUT_BRANCH=main \
    INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH='callisto/version-packages' \
    INPUT_CWD=. \
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY='orin-dx/callisto' \
    bash -c 'source "$1"; source "$2"' -- "$harness" "$script" > /dev/null 2>&1
  local code=$?
  set -e

  printf '%s\n---calls---\n' "$code"
  cat "$calls_file"
  printf '%s\n' '---outputs---'
  cat "$output_file"
  rm -f "$calls_file" "$output_file" "$harness" "$verify_count_file"
}
